old_value: {"id":"erpl-adt-jey","title":"Fix activation result parsing: ioc:inactiveObjects entries must count as failure even with no msg elements","description":"ParseActivationResultXml in activation.cpp counts messages from chkl:messages to determine total/activated/failed. When SAP returns 200 with no msg elements but ioc:inactiveObjects entries still present, the function returns total=0 and the CLI reports 'Nothing to activate' — a false success. This was the direct cause of the class write+activate bug in this session where inactive version existed but activation was silently dropped. Fix: after parsing messages, check ioc:inactiveObjects for remaining ioc:entry elements and increment failed+total for each. File: src/adt/activation.cpp ParseActivationResultXml(). new_value: Fixed: ParseActivationResultXml now detects SAP Cloud format (chkl:messages as root), parses chkl:properties activationExecuted attribute, and sets ActivationResult::activation_executed. ReportActivationOutcome distinguishes clean activation from nothing-to-activate. 3 new regression tests added.
